why: a months lesson written the way a Chinese teacher writes it must not come back empty
note: The round-2 date rule read every `1月` as a date and deleted the whole paste: zero cards, which also sends the worker to the paid model rescue (RESCUE_BELOW_ITEMS). A date now needs two units in calendar order, so a single `1月` is left alone. Round 2e went further: on a list, `1月` through `12月` is now its own card, written the way she typed it, with pinyin and an English month name filled in on the server (monthOrDayCard in shared/extract.ts). The old answer, a single repeated `月` card, was honest but not what a months lesson teaches.
